[[File:Japanese-Hoth-Snowtrooper-Officer-PSA-82917266.jpg|thumb|center|340px|Japanese Snowtrooper Officer printing.]]

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">スノートルーパー士官</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。同じ位置に配備するならスノートルーパーは配備コスト－1。自分の兵員／トルーパーはホスの同じ位置に向かってリアクションとして移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">スノートルーパーのエリート士官。帝国陸軍の士官の常として、反乱軍の戦法には精通している。歩兵とＡＴ－ＡＴを連係させる要として働く。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Snowtrooper Officer.

'''Lore''' — An elite Snowtrooper officer. Like other Imperial Army officers, he is well versed in Rebel tactics. He serves as the link between the infantry and the AT-ATs.

'''Game text''' — Deploy only on Hoth. Afterward, may move anywhere. Snowtroopers deploy for 1 less to the same location. Your personnel or troopers may move to the same location on Hoth as a react.

Both photographed Japanese faces print ability 1. The English original prints ability 2. The ordinary Japanese title has three asterisks. The photographed variant has a blank title strip.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-snowtrooperofficer.gif|Original English face]], [[Snowtrooper Officer]].</ref>

== Missing-title variant ==
The collecting encyclopedia records a Japanese printing of Snowtrooper Officer with a blank title strip.<ref name="missing-title-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

[[File:Japanese-Hoth-Snowtrooper-Officer-Missing-Title-Encyclopedia32-p48.png|thumb|center|340px|Japanese Snowtrooper Officer with a blank title strip.]]

Destiny 2, power 2, ability 1, deploy 3, and forfeit 3. The [[Imperial]] and [[Warrior]] icons appear on the face. The title strip is blank.<ref name="missing-title-face" />

=== Japanese text on the variant ===
'''Lore''' — <span lang="ja">スノートルーパーのエリート士官。帝国陸軍の士官の常として、反乱軍の戦法には精通している。歩兵とＡＴ－ＡＴを連係させる要として働く。</span><ref name="missing-title-face" />

'''Game text''' — <span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。同じ位置に配備するならスノートルーパーは配備コスト－1。自分の兵員／トルーパーはホスの同じ位置に向かってリアクションとして移動できる。</span><ref name="missing-title-face" />

=== Translation of Japanese Text ===
'''Lore''' — An elite Snowtrooper officer. Like other Imperial Army officers, he is well versed in Rebel tactics. He serves as the link between the infantry and the AT-ATs.

'''Game text''' — Deploys only on Hoth. After that, he can move anywhere. Snowtroopers deploy for 1 less to the same location. Your personnel or troopers can move to the same location on Hoth as a react.

The English face prints ability 2 and a title with three restriction dots. The pictured Japanese variant prints ability 1 and has a blank title strip. The English game text says “site,” where the Japanese variant says 位置 (location).<ref name="missing-title-face" /><ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-snowtrooperofficer.gif|Original English face]], [[Snowtrooper Officer]].</ref>
